name: checkbox-group
summary: Renders a bounded native fieldset of independently selectable checkbox choices.

agent.useWhen: An app-owned form needs 1–20 independently selectable options with shared context.
agent.avoidWhen: Choices are dynamic, require rich content, custom transport, client-side state, or a command lifecycle.

invariants: Uses native fieldset/legend and repeated checkbox names; the browser owns successful-control form semantics.
Contains 1..=20 choices with unique nonblank values; each choice has a nonblank label and optional nonblank hint.
An optional safe explicit id names the fieldset; otherwise name is used. Choice, hint, error, and description IDs are deterministic and reserved.
Layout is stacked or inline. Group and per-choice disabled states use native disabled controls.
Names and IDs are non-reserved safe tokens; all copy and values are control-safe plain text escaped as HTML.
The app owns form, submission, transport, routes, and domain validation. No hidden transport, JavaScript, commands, arbitrary attributes, or raw markup are emitted.
The fragment has exactly one [[attributes]], [[legend]], [[choices]], and [[description]] slot; expansion is exact and single-pass.
Draft status remains until a Native host build and browser review prove admission and behavior.
